english.title: Remove / tamper with a seal / lock / mark used to secure / identify goods under the Customs and Excise Acts
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[wilfully and prematurely removed a seal securing or identifying goods]_
(B)_[wilfully and prematurely tampered with a seal securing or identifying goods]_
(C)_[wilfully and prematurely removed a lock securing goods]_
(D)_[wilfully and prematurely tampered with a lock securing goods]_
(E)_[wilfully and prematurely removed a mark identifying goods]_
(F)_[wilfully and prematurely tampered with a mark identifying goods]_
(G)_[were in charge of goods secured or identified by a seal which had been removed]_
(H)_[were in charge of goods secured or identified by a seal which had been tampered with]_
(I)_[were in charge of goods secured by a lock which had been removed]_
(J)_[were in charge of goods secured by a lock which had been tampered with]_
(K)_[were in charge of goods identified by a mark which had been removed]_
(L)_[were in charge of goods identified by a mark which had been tampered with]_

the goods being

(M)_[in the United Kingdom]_
(N)_[within the limits of a port, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORT..), in the United Kingdom]_
(O)_[on passage between ports in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORTS..),]_
(P)_[between a port in the United Kingdom and a port in the Isle of Man, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORTS..),]_

and the

(Q)_[seal]_
(R)_[lock]_
(S)_[mark]_

being used to secure or identify those goods for the purpose of the Customs and Excise Acts in pursuance of those Acts or a requirement imposed by or under those Acts
english.legislation: Contrary to section 83(1)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
wilfully and prematurely
remove / tamper with a seal / lock / mark OR
in charge of goods secured / identified by
such a seal / lock / mark which was removed / tampered with
whilst the goods are in the UK OR
within the limits of a port / on passage between ports in the UK OR
between a port in the UK Kingdom and a port in the Isle of Man
the seal / lock / mark being used
to secure / identify goods for the purpose of and
in pursuance of the Customs and Excise Acts or
a requirement imposed by / under those Acts

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 1 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that "Customs and Excise Acts" means the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 and any other enactment being in force relating to customs or excise.

(B)_[yn fwriadol ac yn rhy gynnar, ymyrryd â sêl a oedd yn diogelu neu yn adnabod nwyddau]_

(S)_[marc]_
